critical_code_review_comments: Fix is well-scoped: className added to the 3 <svg> elements and CSS overrides use attribute-prefix selectors (stroke^='rgba(255,255,255', fill^='rgba(180,180,180', fill^='rgba(230,0,0,0.12') gated under `html.light`, so dark mode is untouched.
Minor: CSS uses `stroke^="rgba(255,255,255"` (no space) which correctly matches JSX values written without a trailing space after the comma. Consistent with the JSX. No fix needed.

Consider extracting the venture glyph SVGs into a `theme-aware` React component using CSS custom properties (--glyph-stroke) instead of attribute-selector overrides, so future colour tweaks are DRY. Non-blocking.

rca of the issue: Root cause was hardcoded rgba(255,255,255,...) strokes/fills in the SVG shapes which were invisible on the white light-mode canvas. Fix pattern: add a stable class `venture-glyph-svg` and use CSS attribute-prefix selectors under `html.light` to remap the whites to rgba(0,0,0,0.18) and the grey scattered dots to rgba(60,60,60,0.5). Verified: computed styles now correctly reflect the override in light mode and the original values in dark mode.
